protocol.streaming: One state reset per file; continuous recurrent state through causal STFT and flush hops; no chunk resets
protocol.si_snr_48k_db: Mean-centered SI-SNR on native 48 kHz aligned waveforms
protocol.sigmos: Official cached Microsoft SIGMOS v1, seven MOS dimensions, unmodified 48 kHz PCM
protocol.pesq_wb_16k: PESQ wideband explicitly resampled from 48 kHz to 16 kHz with scipy.signal.resample_poly(1,3); not a 48 kHz PESQ metric
protocol.stoi: pystoi.stoi(clean, enhanced, 48000), standard STOI; implementation internally resamples to 10 kHz
protocol.low_level: Cached -50 dBFS clean RMS fixtures; identical gain on speech and mixture; raw scores and a separate common inverse-gain score after enhancement
protocol.long_noise: Three cached 120-second speech-free noise streams; attenuation/amplification/clipping/state metrics, no referenced speech-quality metrics
protocol.aggregation: Unweighted per-clip means and paired candidate-minus-baseline deltas; missing metrics stay null and report coverage
protocol.parallelism: Independent files in worker processes; one thread per native model, ORT session, and math runtime; not a latency benchmark

provenance.selection: Fixed six IDs first (one per speaker), then deterministic speaker-balanced SHA256 order within the original 50; selected before candidate scoring
